paragraphs.text: A cash-secured put involves selling a put option while holding enough cash to buy the underlying shares at the strike price if you are assigned [S1]. Assignment is the mechanism where an option writer is obliged to take the shares because a holder has exercised their option [S2]. Furthermore, LEAPS, which stand for Long-term Equity AnticiPation Securities, are listed options with more than a year until expiration and can be used to gain long exposure to a stock while requiring less capital than direct share ownership [S3].

The quality screening process evaluated the underlying assets and found {{quality_screen.passed_count}} underlyings passed the criteria, while {{counts.skipped_total}} positions were skipped in total, as detailed in the errors regarding tickers like CAVA, ONON, and DECK, which were not on the good-to-own list.

An option premium is composed of intrinsic value, which is the direct monetary value based on whether the option is in-the-money, and extrinsic value, also known as time value, which is the remainder of the premium [S4]. A poor man's covered call (PMCC) is a strategy that uses a long, deep in-the-money LEAPS call paired with a short, near-term, out-of-the-money call on the same stock [S5].

The strategy deployment resulted in no sized positions, as indicated by {{counts.positions_sized}} positions; this outcome is attributed to the account being too small for the top-ranked candidates, as noted in {{risk.warnings[0]}}.
The risk assessment confirmed that {{risk.checks_passed}} of the {{risk.checks_total}} defined risk checks passed for the portfolio.
